stories.headline: The world is on track to miss its health targets
stories.dek: Every year the World Health Organization publishes a global health statistics report. It features the numbers behind world health trends and, importantly, assesses whether we’re on track to reach ambitious goals set in 2015. It’s a bit like a health grade. The 2026 report was published on Wednesday.

stories.headline: Power prices are up 76% on America’s biggest grid, and a watchdog is pointing fingers
stories.dek: The price spike is a reminder of a deeper problem: The U.S. power grid was not designed for the electricity demands of an AI-driven economy, and the gap between what the grid can deliver and what the industry needs is widening.

stories.headline: Meridian Ventures launched a $35M fund with a focus on MBA-deferred founders
stories.dek: This new fund will back founders building enterprise technology in the United States. Meridian is agnostic, co-founder Devon Gethers said, noting that the firm has already invested in companies in fintech, logistics, healthcare, and of course, AI.
